# Flutter Supabase Doctor — supabase_flutter deep links

> Free, client-side checker that finds why a Supabase Auth OAuth or magic-link deep link never returns to a Flutter app built with supabase_flutter, and gives the exact fix for Info.plist, AndroidManifest.xml, the Supabase dashboard, or your Dart code.

Fill in your app's URL scheme/host, launch mode, flow type, Supabase project URL / Site URL / Redirect URLs allow-list, the OAuth provider, and a few flags about your code, and it cross-checks them against what iOS, Android, and Supabase's own redirect matching actually require — no account, no backend, nothing you type leaves your browser.

## What it checks

- Scheme validity: empty, reserved (`http`/`https`), uppercase, whitespace, or an underscore in the scheme/host — underscores silently fail Google's OAuth redirect matching and fall back to Site URL ([supabase/auth#2447](https://github.com/supabase/auth/issues/2447)).
- `redirectTo` vs. `scheme://host`: whether your Dart code's `redirectTo` matches exactly (a trailing slash is enough to break it).
- Supabase Redirect URLs allow-list coverage, matched with the same glob syntax Supabase uses (`*`, `**`, `?`, character classes).
- iOS `Info.plist`: whether `CFBundleURLSchemes` actually lists your scheme.
- Android `AndroidManifest.xml`: whether the intent-filter's `android:scheme` / `android:host` match, and whether `android:autoVerify="true"` was left on (no effect on a custom scheme).
- `authScreenLaunchMode`: flags `LaunchMode.inAppWebView`, which hangs several providers (Kakao, Discord, Facebook) that refuse to complete inside an embedded WebView.
- `authFlowType`: recommends PKCE over implicit for native apps.
- OAuth provider console (Google, Apple, GitHub, Discord, Kakao): whether it has the exact `https://<ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback`, and flags the common mistake of pasting your app's own scheme there instead.
- Whether you listen to `onAuthStateChange` — without it, sign-in can complete while the UI still shows a logged-out screen.

## Who it's for

Flutter developers using `supabase_flutter` for OAuth or magic-link sign-in whose redirect hangs on the provider's page, opens Safari/Chrome Custom Tabs and stops there, or brings the app back to the foreground still signed out.

## How it works

Static HTML plus one dependency-free JavaScript file, `doctor-flutter.js`. All checks run in your browser against the values you type; the tool has no backend and makes no request that carries your configuration anywhere.

## Privacy

No account, no login, no cookies for the tool itself, no server-side processing of your config. The only analytics are anonymous usage counts (event name + count, never the content of what you entered) sent to a self-hosted Umami instance.
